title: Sales Engineer (all genders)
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

As AI agents become capable of executing increasingly complex workflows, enterprise customers expect more than presentations-they want to see working solutions inside their own environments.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Engineer, you're not just supporting sales.

You're helping some of the world's largest enterprises understand what's technically possible with AI. You'll build prototypes, lead technical workshops, and work closely with customers to turn complex requirements into working software that proves real business value.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

In this role, you will:

- Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and custom solutions that demonstrate the value of our platform

- Configure and adapt Lio's AI platform to customer workflows and enterprise system landscapes

- Lead technical deep dives, live demos, and workshops with procurement, IT, and architecture teams

- Partner closely with Sales throughout the entire enterprise sales process as the technical expert

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer needs into scalable product capabilities

- Travel to customer sites for workshops and technical sessions (1-2 times per week)

- Help shape how enterprise customers adopt AI in complex production environments

YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive in this role if you:

- Have experience building software. You're comfortable working with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or modern development frameworks.

- Enjoy solving customer problems. You like understanding technical requirements and turning them into working solutions.

- Take ownership by default. You move quickly, build pragmatically, and care about delivering measurable customer value.

- Communicate confidently. You're comfortable presenting technical concepts to engineers, IT teams, and senior stakeholders alike.

- Enjoy working across disciplines. You like collaborating with Sales, Product, Engineering, and customers to make complex projects successful.

- Are curious about AI and excited about bringing cutting-edge technology into enterprise environments.

WHAT'S NOT REQUIRED

You don't need experience in procurement software or every technology in our stack.

We're much more interested in strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and your ability to solve customer problems than in checking every box on a technology list.

WHY JOIN LIO?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator. We're bringing Silicon Valley ambition and speed to Munich while building one of Europe's leading AI companies.

From day one, you'll work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, helping some of the world's largest enterprises adopt AI. You'll build real solutions, influence our product through customer feedback, and work closely with founders, Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how enterprise AI is deployed.

If you're excited about combining engineering, customer interaction, and cutting-edge AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Any questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Cansel https://www.linkedin.com/in/cansel-bayram-6a422420b/.

• Write thorough negative, boundary, and edge-case scenarios across IVR, chat bot, and customer service workflows - not just happy-path coverage

title: Launch Campaign Technical Program Manager
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

The Launch Campaign Technical Program Manager (TPM) shall provide strategic, operational, and programmatic support to the AST Launch Director in the planning, coordination, execution, and continuous improvement of satellite launch campaigns and associated launch logistics, infrastructure, and operational readiness initiatives. The TPM will serve as a trusted advisor and extension of the Launch Director's organization, helping coordinate cross-functional activities, identify risks, drive closure of action items, and support successful mission execution.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the Launch Director in developing and maintaining integrated launch campaign plans, schedules, milestones, and readiness metrics.

• Assist in coordinating campaign activities across engineering, manufacturing, AI&T, mission operations, supply chain, logistics, launch service providers, and other stakeholders.

• Monitor campaign readiness status and identify schedule, resource, technical, operational, or logistical risks requiring management attention.

• Support preparation for launch readiness reviews, operational readiness reviews, campaign milestones, and executive briefings.

• Assist the Launch Director in coordinating spacecraft transportation, ground support equipment deployment, personnel movement, and launch-site operational activities.

• Support logistics planning and coordination with launch service providers, transportation vendors, customs agencies, and launch-site personnel.

• Support development and maintenance of launch campaign logistics plans and operational procedures.

• Support planning and execution of launch-related infrastructure projects, facility enhancements, and operational capability improvements.

• Assist in evaluating launch-site facilities, support equipment, consumables, communications systems, and operational resources necessary to support campaign objectives.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure launch activities align with campaign schedules and mission requirements.

• Maintain readiness dashboards, action-item trackers, risk registers, and status reporting tools.

• Support budget, resource, and supplier coordination activities related to launch campaigns and associated projects.

• Support establishment of best practices, campaign standards, and operational procedures to improve efficiency and mission success.

Qualifications  

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a STEM-related field  

Experience:

A minimum of 5 years of program management or mission management experience  

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with LEO satellite constellations

• Familiarity with mission planning and launch operations

• Knowledge of launch vehicles and payload accommodations

• Experience testing complex systems

• Experience working with heavy loads under cranes

• Prior work in a 24/7 operations environment

• Exposure to automation and AI enabled tools  

Soft Skills

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail to ensure the accuracy of all documentation and project deliverables

• Self-starter with initiative and ownership mindset

• Adaptability to rapidly evolving system requirements  

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods

• Ability to lift up

title: Sr. Global Alliance Director, Channel and GSI
description:
As Director Global Alliance Leader at vCluster Labs , you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building the channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room. Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in GSIs, ISVs, and distributors where they accelerate a reseller deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP. (Internally titled Director, Alliances, Channel & VARs)
This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. There is no channel to inherit and no team underneath you. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.
As Sr. Global Alliance Director, Channel and GSI, your role will include:

• Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction (agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, first close) and retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

• Transaction mechanics: You will own the reseller commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record (regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account), and build distribution where it scales the motion while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

• Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers with deal registration the field trusts, and give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

• Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect reseller opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a GSI, ISV, or distributor accelerates a reseller deal, you bring them in.

• Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached (field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, customer stories) and approve MDF against pipeline outcomes with proof of performance enforced. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

• Owning the channel number: MEDDPICC on every partner-attached opportunity. Weekly pipeline inspection. Partner attribution queryable from day one; pipeline we cannot query is pipeline we do not have. QBRs on a fixed cadence with a fixed agenda: bookings against plan, named-account inspection, certification status, marketing execution, renewal health, forward-quarter plan. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs; you report your KPIs without being asked: transacting partners, sourced and attached pipeline and bookings, registration volume and win rate, certified resources, MDF return.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

• Channel leadership with a number behind it: 8+ years in channel, reseller, or partner sales in infrastructure software, AI infra

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About the role
We are building AI systems that generate production-quality motion from natural language. The system combines frontier language models, an AI generation harness, and a text-native Motion DSL designed for structured, editable animation.
This role spans two connected areas: improving the production generation system used today, and developing specialized models that can generate the Motion DSL directly with higher quality, lower latency, and better cost efficiency.
You will work at the intersection of LLM systems, post-training, code generation, compilers, evaluation, data engineering, and motion design. This is a hands-on engineering role with end-to-end ownership and measurable product impact.
Key Responsibilities
Build and improve production generative systems

• Design and ship improvements across prompt interpretation, model orchestration, routing, retrieval, tool use, structured generation, validation, repair, and visual verification.

• Diagnose recurring failure modes and turn them into durable improvements in prompts, data, system logic, constraints, or evaluation.

• Build compiler-backed feedback loops and deterministic quality gates that prevent invalid or low-quality outputs from reaching users.

• Develop experiments and fixed evaluation batteries that show whether a change genuinely improves output quality.

Train specialized generative models

• Design supervised fine-tuning datasets, training recipes, and post-training experiments for direct Motion DSL generation.

• Explore distillation, preference optimization, synthetic-data generation, reinforcement-learning approaches, and constrained generation where they are the right tools.

• Select checkpoints using robust evaluations across correctness, visual quality, reliability, latency, and cost - not training loss alone.

• Determine whether a model failure is best addressed through data, training, inference, evaluation, or the underlying language/runtime.

Build the data and evaluation foundation

• Turn production generations into high-quality training and evaluation datasets using filtering, provenance, versioning, deduplication, and contamination controls.

• Design train, validation, and evaluation splits that minimize leakage and preserve meaningful generalization tests.

• Create failure taxonomies, hard negatives, regression suites, and representative prompt batteries.

• Combine deterministic checks, model-based judges, render evidence, and human review into a reliable evaluation system.

What we're looking for

• Strong ML and software engineering
You have built and operated production AI or machine-learning systems, not only prototypes. You are comfortable moving across model behavior, data pipelines, APIs, infrastructure, evaluation, and product code.

• Hands-on LLM training experience
You have practical experience with supervised fine-tuning and modern post-training workflows. You understand how dataset construction affects model behavior and can explain how you prevent leakage, contamination, and misleading evaluation results.

• Strong evaluation instincts
You know that generative systems improve only when they can be measured. You can design experiments, regression suites, automated graders, and evaluation datasets that distinguish real gains from noise.

• Experience with structured or code generation
Experience with code-generation models, DSLs, grammars, parsers, compilers, structured outputs, constrained decoding, or program synthesis is especially relevant. The generated output is executable structured code, so syntactic and semantic correctness both matter.

• Production engineering judgment
You treat observability, reliability, latency, inference cost, caching, failure recovery, and maintainability as part of the ML system itself.

• Product and visual judgment
You can distinguish technically valid output from work that feels polished. Experience with animation, motion design, graphics, creative tooling, or multimodal system

• Collaborate with onboard and research engineers to expand simulation capabilities and achieve critical Waymo milestones.

• UK Market Experience: Proven track record working on UK-facing inbound or outbound sales and qualification campaigns.

• Scripted Execution: Demonstrated ability to follow structured scripts naturally while building authentic rapport with customers.

Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

title: Head of CBM unit

Про роль
Чи можливо по-справжньому розуміти мільйони клієнтів? Передбачати їхні потреби, пропонувати правильні рішення в правильний момент та створювати досвід, який формує довіру і лояльність на роки?

Ця роль поєднує стратегічне управління клієнтською базою, аналітику, Customer Value Management, клієнтський досвід та комерційний розвиток. Ви будете формувати підходи до управління життєвим циклом клієнта, розвивати персоналізацію взаємодії та впливати на рішення, які визначають майбутнє клієнтського досвіду в екосистемі Київстар.
Якщо вас надихає можливість будувати клієнтоцентричний бізнес на основі даних, впливати на досвід мільйонів клієнтів та вести команду до амбітних результатів, будемо раді познайомитися.
Основні обов'язки:
Розвиток Customer Value Management
Визначати та реалізовувати стратегію розвитку Customer Value Management у компанії.
Формувати та вдосконалювати клієнтські сценарії розвитку споживання продуктів і сервісів екосистеми Київстар.
Розвивати підходи Next Best Offer та Next Best Action для персоналізації взаємодії з клієнтами.
Впроваджувати автоматизовані механізми ухвалення рішень на основі даних і поведінкових моделей клієнтів.
Аналізувати зміни клієнтської поведінки, ринкові тренди та нові можливості для розвитку клієнтської цінності.
Управління та розвиток клієнтської бази
Розробляти моделі сегментації клієнтської бази та прогнозування клієнтської поведінки.
Виявляти фактори, що впливають на залучення, утримання та розвиток клієнтів.
Формувати стратегії підвищення лояльності, життєвої цінності клієнта (Customer Lifetime Value) та довгострокового зростання бізнесу.
Використовувати аналітику, дослідження клієнтського досвіду та показники задоволеності для визначення пріоритетних напрямів розвитку.
Забезпечувати синхронізацію потреб клієнтів із продуктовими, маркетинговими та комерційними командами.
Лідерство та управління командою
Формувати бачення розвитку функції CBM та забезпечувати його реалізацію.
Керувати командою аналітиків та експертів Customer Base Management.
Встановлювати цілі та KPI напряму, контролювати їх виконання.
Розвивати культуру прийняття рішень на основі даних та клієнтоцентричного підходу.
Наш ідеальний кандидат
Має досвід управління командами у сферах CRM, CVM, Customer Analytics, Marketing Analytics або Commercial Excellence.
Володіє глибоким розумінням клієнтської аналітики, сегментації та персоналізації.
Має досвід побудови програм утримання та розвитку клієнтської бази.
Вміє працювати на перетині бізнесу, аналітики, продуктів та маркетингу.
Мислить стратегічно та вміє трансформувати інсайти в бізнес-результат.
Має сильні комунікаційні та лідерські навички.
Зростання показників клієнтської лояльності та задоволеності.

About us:
At Fullbay , our mission is simple - to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation- for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.
Position Overview:
Fullbay runs on a growing portfolio of business applications, and the Integration & Automation Engineer makes them work as one system. You'll design, build, and operate the integrations, data pipelines, and automations that connect Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, and the Snowflake data warehouse, so data moves reliably, manual work disappears, and reporting can be trusted.
This is a core technical seat inside IT and Security, and an early one. You'll set the standards for how integrations get built, monitored, documented, and secured, all while supporting two parallel product platforms during the migration. The work also lays the foundation for how AI agents access Fullbay 's data, which makes this a chance to shape both how the company runs today and how it uses AI tomorrow.
The Right Wrench for the Job
In a heavy-duty shop, the best technicians know that a truck doesn't run on one good part. It runs because the fuel system, the electrical harness, and the ECM all talk to each other without anyone thinking about it. When one connection fails, the whole rig sits in the bay. That's the work this role owns: the connections nobody notices until they break.

You're comfortable moving from an API doc to a Snowflake model to a runbook in the same afternoon, you treat credentials and service accounts with the care they deserve, and you're curious about how AI agents will tap into company data in the years ahead.
This isn't the role for someone who needs a dedicated integration team, an established architecture, and a backlog that's already been scoped. But if you're energized by building the plumbing from scratch, enjoy partnering with Finance, RevOps, and IT to turn manual pain into reliable automation, and want to help define how Fullbay 's data works for both people and agents, we'd like to talk.

• ETL: Airbyte, Google Cloud Datastream

Hercules ’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process:

• We ship . We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers.

• We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

• We are hungry . We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?
Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.
What are Hercules ’ benefits?

• Unlimited AI token budget

• Take what you need vacation policy

• Healthcare, vision, and dental

• Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

• We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?
$100k-$250k + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 交易询价方向
description:
【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.
The Role
BeyondTrust is building a new cross-product Site Reliability Engineering team that stands up and runs the AWS GovCloud environments bringing additional BeyondTrust products into our FedRAMP authorization. The team owns the reliability, change control, and continuous-compliance machinery for those environments so that product feature teams can stay focused on product delivery.
This is an engineering team that owns operations, not an operations team. Its product is automation; operations is the input. Every manual procedure performed twice is a candidate for elimination, and the team’s success is measured by the operational work it has made unnecessary, not the tickets it has closed. Hands-on operational work is capped at roughly half of team capacity; the rest goes to engineering the work away.

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager, Quantum Systems Infrastructure
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: Oxford, England
Travel: As needed
Job ID: 1905

The Role:

We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to join the Quantum Systems Infrastructure (QSI) team at IonQ's Oxford office. QSI builds and runs the platform our next-generation quantum computers are built, tested, released and operated on, from bare metal in the lab to cloud, working across both Oxford and the US.

Your mission is to run the machinery that keeps QSI’s portfolio visible, planned and unblocked so engineers can engineer, leaders can lead, and the business always knows what is changing and why it matters. You will work very closely with the Technical Programme Managers in the Software and Science teams, ensuring our processes and workflows complement and integrate with their work, rather than duplicating effort. 

We run a centralised PMO operating model at IonQ which you will be a core part of though on a day to day basis you will work alongside the QSI team. As part of this model, this role will not make technical decisions, own engineering headcount, or define product but it will make the programme around those things run.

You will own programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams, translating a leadership-visible roadmap into clear plans, measurable milestones and predictable delivery. You will create and run the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned and leaders informed. When priorities shift, you will implement structure to that ambiguity, clarifying scope, coordinating trade-offs and pushing problems to resolution.

Key responsibilities include:

• Owning programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams: one planning rhythm, one backlog discipline, ensuring dependencies and risks surfaced early and chased to resolution.

• Running the roadmap-to-delivery link: keeping the roadmap, Jira and reality agreeing with each other, and making slippage visible early.

• Owning the programme ceremonies and the design of the workflows behind them (day-to-day stand-ups are run by the engineering managers).

• Working hand-in-hand with the Software and Science TPMs: shared or integrated processes wherever teams interact, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reporting.

• Coordinating across teams - Continuing Engineering (US), the PMO, product and science teams - serving as QSI’s cross-functional programme liaison.

• Establishing programme cadences and reporting (changelogs, demos, leadership summaries etc) in plain English that non-infrastructure stakeholders can read and trust.

• Running the intake and triage process so requests reach the right stream with the right priority, without engineers being interrupt-driven.

Ти закуповуватимеш трафік у Meta для наших продуктів і з перших тижнів працюватимеш з кампаніями. На цю роль ми готові розглядати студентів старших курсів і кандидатів без досвіду в закупці, досвід допоможемо набрати. Нам важливіше, як ти думаєш і як швидко вчишся, ніж що написано в резюме.

Твої ключові завдання:
- Розібратись у перформанс-маркетингу з нуля. Навчишся запускати й вести рекламні кампанії в Meta на ринках по всьому світу.
- Керувати бюджетом через цифри. Щодня дивитимешся на ROI, CPA, LTV і вирішуватимеш, що масштабувати, що оптимізувати, а що вимикати.
- Тестувати гіпотези. Аудиторії, гео, формати, креативи: формулюєш гіпотезу, запускаєш тест, аналізуєш результат і робиш висновок.
- Шукати точки росту. Помічати аномалії в даних, розбиратись, чому метрика просіла чи злетіла, і першим знаходити нові можливості для масштабування.

Що для нас важливо:
Бажання рости в маркетингу і готовність брати відповідальність. Якщо ти кайфуєш від цифр і швидко вчишся, решту ми покажемо.

Must-have:
- Англійська B2+. Ти працюватимеш з англомовними рекламними платформами та ринками.
- Аналітичний склад розуму та любов до цифр. Тобі в задоволення копатися в даних, шукати закономірності й причинно-наслідкові звʼязки.
- Бізнес-орієнтованість і системна допитливість. Тобі важливо, щоб бізнес ріс. Ти не боїшся складних систем і завжди питаєш «як це працює?» і «чому саме так?».
- Відповідальність і уважність до деталей. Ти керуватимеш бюджетами бізнесу.

Буде плюсом:
- Аналітична, технічна чи економічна освіта.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

 

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.
- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.
- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.
- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About the role

Thatch is rethinking how health insurance is provided and used in the US, and compliance is core to what we do. Our compliance obligations span insurance regulation, financial services, employee benefits, and IRS requirements-often at the same time. You'll be part of the team that keeps that program running: reviewing marketing and advertising against state insurance rules and federal advertising requirements, executing our monitoring and testing procedures and documenting the results, and working second-line review of customer accounts and transaction monitoring escalations. You'll do this alongside experienced compliance and legal colleagues and, regardless of your level, will learn so much as you help build this function out. We're looking for someone with a few years of compliance or regulatory experience who is precise, organized, and genuinely interested in  why a rule exists, not just whether a box got checked.

What you'll do

• Review marketing copy and customer-facing materials against policy, rules, and requirements. Maintain the advertising files and approval records those rules require

• Support monitoring and testing procedures: pull samples, gather evidence, document results, and track identified issues through remediation

• Work second-line review of customer onboarding (KYB/C) and transaction monitoring escalations, complete enhanced due diligence (EDD) requests, document dispositions, and escalate cases that warrant review by senior team members or financial partners

• Maintain compliance recordkeeping, policy and procedure documentation, and the evidence needed to support audits, examinations, and partner diligence

• Partner with teams around Thatch including Marketing, Product, Operations, and Financial Partnerships to answer routine compliance questions and route the harder ones to the right person

• Support employee compliance training delivery and completion tracking

Background we're looking for

• Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience in compliance, regulatory operations, risk, audit, or a closely related function

• Exposure to at least one regulated environment - insurance, banking or payments, securities, healthcare, or benefits

• Strong writing skills and real precision with detail; you can document what you did clearly enough that someone else can rely on it a year later

• Highly organized with a demonstrated ability to manage recurring workflows and competing deadlines without dropping threads

• Curiosity about overlapping regulatory regimes and the judgment to know when to ask rather than assume

• Good sense of humor… you work in compliance, so it's ok if it is a little dark

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

• Experience in health insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry

• Hands-on KYB/C, AML, or transaction monitoring alert review experience

• Experience executing control testing or supporting an audit or regulatory examination

• Comfort with modern compliance tooling and an interest in using AI to make recurring review work faster and better documented

• Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where the procedure didn't exist yet or decision frameworks are evolving

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

• 30 minute video meeting to talk through your background and interest in Thatch

• 30 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience and the role

• 30 minute video meeting to meet 2-3 members of the team

• 30 minute video meeting with department leadership to discuss alignment to the role and career goals

• 30 minute video meeting with our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principle

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

We are a small, dynamic team focused on building cloud-managed intercom systems. Intercom is our second newest major product line and is off to the best start of any product in Verkada’s history. Our intercom allows customers to receive calls from anywhere - at their desk or on their phone - with rich video and 2-way audio, and we have a lot more to build.

We consider our team a startup within a startup, with a fair amount of ownership and autonomy. You’ll be working alongside a dynamic team of firmware, mobile, and frontend engineers to develop this product line.

The Intercom product line is a critical component of our intelligent building ecosystem, delivering rich, low-latency, multimodal interactions (video, audio, and access control integration) directly at the environment’s edge. This is a "startup within a startup" opportunity where you will have significant ownership over the architectural direction of this burgeoning product line, which is already the most successful launch in Verkada history. title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Developer Infrastructure team builds the systems Sentry engineers use to develop, test, and ship software. We own local and cloud development environments, CI/CD across our open-source and private codebases, tooling for creating new services, and SDK and library publishing.

Our goal is to help engineers spend more time building for customers and less time troubleshooting their development tools. You’ll work on problems such as shortening CI feedback cycles, improving deployment reliability, detecting flaky tests, and making development environments easier to use and maintain.

As AI coding agents become part of engineering workflows, you’ll also help our environments, CI, and deployment systems support them with the context and access they need.

You’ll own projects from design through rollout and ongoing operation, working directly with engineers across Sentry to understand their needs and measure whether your changes improve their work.

This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office to work closely with Platform and Product Engineering teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and maintain tooling for local and cloud development environments.

- Improve the speed and reliability of CI and deployment pipelines as our codebases and infrastructure grow.

- Develop supported, reusable workflows for creating services and libraries.

- Improve SDK and library publishing tools and release processes.

- Build metrics, dashboards, and flaky test detection to help teams identify and resolve development and deployment problems.

- Give engineers and AI coding agents the context they need to work within Sentry’s systems and conventions.

- Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements, support adoption, and evaluate results.

HOW YOU WORK

- You enjoy building tools and infrastructure other engineers rely on.

- You consider reliability, performance, cost, and maintenance when making technical decisions.

- You take ownership from understanding a problem through implementation, rollout, and operation.

- You listen to engineers’ feedback and use evidence to guide improvements.

- You help teams adopt shared tools and standards through clear reasoning and collaboration.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience building developer tools and infrastructure.

- A track record of building or significantly improving developer tooling or infrastructure used by engineering teams.

- Strong proficiency in Python.

- Experience improving CI/CD systems, including diagnosing performance or reliability problems.

- Experience leading complex technical projects through design, implementation, and rollout.

- Experience using Docker and container orchestration in production.

- Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as GCP or AWS.
